patch_description: Restructure into a modular pipeline: (1) a graph prep stage, (2) a single multicast Steiner-tree builder using the closest-attachment heuristic (Dijkstra from each remaining destination to the current tree via the reversed graph), and (3) a topology writer. The key structural change versus the current program: the tree is built **once** and reused for all partitions, and per-destination paths are reconstructed by walking up the parent map, with an unreachable-node guard (`nx.has_path` / try/except) so no destination causes a crash. Dedup of tree edges and reuse across all partitions minimizes redundant transfers while keeping load balanced and the output format identical.
